snippet.title: Unclaimed - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
It's 1991. You work alone on the night shift at a remote cargo facility. As you sort shipments and complete your tasks, unexplained noises from the hallways, strange images appearing on security cameras, and a growing sense of unease begin to turn your shift into a nightmare.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4880560/Unclaimed/
